name: Creotech Instruments
description: Creotech Instruments is a publicly traded Polish provider of specialized electronics for quantum computers, satellite systems, and scientific instrumentation. Selected by EuroHPC JU to help build Poland's first quantum computer at the Poznan Supercomputing Center, the company is spinning off its quantum division into a dedicated entity to accelerate development of quantum control systems and QKD hardware.

products.name: Quantum Control Electronics
products.description: Specialized control systems and electronics for operating and managing quantum computing hardware

products.name: QKD Hardware Modules
products.description: Quantum key distribution hardware for secure communications in government and enterprise networks

highlights: Publicly traded Polish company — one of few listed quantum hardware providers in Europe
Selected by EuroHPC JU to help build Poland's first quantum computer at Poznan Supercomputing Center
Secured PLN 74M+ in Series K funding in 2025 to spin off dedicated quantum division

sources.title: EuroHPC JU to Create European Quantum Computing Network with Support from Creotech Instruments

news.title: EuroHPC JU to Create European Quantum Computing Network with Support from Creotech Instruments
news.excerpt: On 27 June 2023, the European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU) formalized agreements to establish and integrate quantum computing networks at six strategic locations across Europe, including Poland. Creotech Instruments will be responsible for the installation of a quantum computer in Poland as part of the High Performance Computing infrastructure of the Poznań Supercomputing and Networking Center. The total project cost is EUR 100 million.
